notes:
v0.6.21: g90-bootstrap.sh + overlay fixes for fresh ReticulumHF install.

The build recipe (BUILD.md) was a hand-typed step-by-step that
accumulated 6+ recipe gaps from this session. The operator
proposed: replace the manual recipe with a bootstrap script
that's tested on a truly fresh box. This release ships the
script + the overlay fixes needed for it to work.

Overlay fixes:
1. g90-image/config/start-novnc-session — was a stub that
   used `x11vnc -nopw` (no password!) and bad structure.
   Replaced with the working version: websockify in
   foreground, x11vnc reads /etc/x11vnc/passwd, properly
   backgrounds the others.

2. g90-image/systemd-units/novnc-session.service — added.
   Points to /home/pi/.local/bin/start-novnc-session.

3. g90-image/systemd-units/zerotier-one.service — added.
   ReticulumHF base's zerotier-one .deb ships a unit file
   but the bookworm base has it stripped (per today's
   work). This is the upstream unit content.

New file:
- scripts/g90-bootstrap.sh (463 lines, 12 phases):
  Phase 0: Sanity check (bookworm, aarch64, network, disk)
  Phase 1: Add ZeroTier apt source
  Phase 2: apt install (system tools + radio apps + noVNC)
  Phase 3: pipx (rns 1.4.2 + lxmf inject + freedvtnc2 + meshchatx)
  Phase 4: modem73 from github releases
  Phase 5: pre-existing service directories
  Phase 6: clone reticulumpi + pin to latest tag
  Phase 7: overlay config + systemd units + x11vnc password
  Phase 8: prepare-* helpers
  Phase 9: systemctl daemon-reload + enable --now
  Phase 10: verify (curl /launcher-status, all components)
  Phase 11: prompt for ZeroTier network ID + join

The script is idempotent (re-runnable). It generates a
random 8-char noVNC password, prints it once at the end.
It uses `set -euo pipefail` so any failure aborts with a
clear error.

What it does NOT do:
- Flash the SD card (operator does with Pi Imager)
- First-boot setup wizard (ReticulumHF base handles it)
- Operator-specific config (SSID, password, callsign)
- Image capture (use BUILD.md Step 8 after the build is verified)

Tested on: nothing yet. The script was written from
yesterday's and today's observations; not yet run end-to-end
on a fresh ReticulumHF base. The next session is the
validation pass.
